data.body: A page is a routed surface: a route, a title, SEO, and an ordered list of sections. Agents create pages, compose them from sections, and publish them; a published page whose route no code file owns is served automatically.

Body fields

  • tracking
  • route (required)
  • pageType (required)
  • title (required)
  • seo (required)
  • template
  • sections (required)
  • navigationOverrides

Patch operations

  • set_page_meta — Merge page meta fields (title/route/seo/…); sections are edited only via section ops.
  • upsert_section
  • update_section_data
  • move_section
  • set_section_visibility
  • remove_section
  • set_tracking

This reference is generated from the live object_contract. If it disagrees with the contract, the manual is wrong and the drift guard fails the build of it.

Worked example

page_publishing_v1 owns the route /manual/publishing-schema-v1 and composes lede, steps, comparison table, and prose sections. It was created, validated, published dark, and released with the rest of this manual.

Lifecycle note

Routes must be unique; page-kind references must resolve; PageType law controls which sections may publish.
